subcategory: parallel per-document KV caches aggregated at decoding time (retrieval-aware contrastive decoding)
task: Multi-document RAG, in-context learning and long-context QA
problem: Concatenating retrieved documents creates prefill bottlenecks, while encoding document KV caches separately is fast but breaks cross-document reasoning.
architecture: PCED: each retrieved document is an 'expert' with its own cached KV state; at every token step expert logits are calibrated against a no-context 'amateur' (context-aware decoding) and weighted by a retrieval prior (log relevance score); the best-supported token is chosen across experts and appended to all histories, stitching evidence across documents without shared attention.
retriever: benchmark passages re-ranked with bge-reranker-v2-m3 (top-90); relevance priors from bge-m3 sparse, dense or ColBERT scores

datasets.name: LOFT
datasets.details: HotpotQA, MuSiQue, NQ, QAMPARI, QUEST (RAG) and ICL tasks

key_results: Llama-3.1-8B on LOFT QAMPARI: 77 (PCED-Sparse) vs 7 for APE KV merging.
Mistral-NeMo-13B on NQ: 81.0 (PCED-Dense) vs 76.0 with all documents in context and 38.0 for APE.
PCED-Dense outperforms full concatenation in 10/16 settings and gives over 180x speedup in time-to-first-token.
With 64 candidates on HotpotQA, PCED-Dense keeps 64 while entropy-based ensembles drop to 14-15.
strengths: Training-free; recovers cross-document reasoning at decode time with large latency gains.
Paired randomisation tests and analysis of robustness to large candidate pools.

limitations.text: Requires full access to per-step logits, so it cannot be used with closed or API-only models.
Depends on retrieval quality and static relevance scores, which may become stale in iterative pipelines.
Precomputed KV caches impose large storage (about 11.04 GB for the LOFT HotpotQA corpus with Llama-3.1-8B).
On Llama-3.1-8B, full-context concatenation is still better on several RAG tasks (e.g. HotpotQA 73 vs 64).

title: Parallel Context-of-Experts Decoding for Retrieval Augmented Generation
